tools.name: get_app_capabilities
tools.description: Return the versioned list of capabilities actually implemented by this app build.

tools.name: get_time_context
tools.description: Return the current Asia/Shanghai date-time and exact ISO dates for yesterday, today, tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow. Call this before every relative-date schedule, attendance, wage, or alarm request.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Read the deterministic resolved schedule for an explicit ISO date range.

tools.name: get_attendance_summary
tools.description: Read a deterministic attendance summary without raw notes or unrelated records.

tools.name: get_wage_summary
tools.description: Read the same deterministic wage summary used by statistics and CSV, only when wage scope is enabled.

tools.name: get_alarm_summary
tools.description: Read a minimal alarm status summary without platform identifiers.

tools.name: get_memories
tools.description: Read a minimal list of locally saved agent memories when they are relevant to the current request and memory permission is enabled.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save one durable memory locally. Call only when the latest user message explicitly asks the agent to remember something; never call merely because information seems useful.

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Soft-delete a locally saved memory. Call only after the latest user message explicitly asks the agent to forget or delete it.

tools.name: update_agent_profile
tools.description: Persist the agent name, personality, and response style locally after the user explicitly provides or changes those preferences.

tools.name: propose_schedule_change
tools.description: Validate and preview temporary work/rest overrides for explicit ISO dates. Never use this tool to change recurring rule presets such as five-day, six-day, alternating-week, or custom cycles. Never applies changes; explicit user confirmation remains required.

tools.name: apply_schedule_change
tools.description: Apply a previously proposed action only with the one-time confirmation token supplied by the local confirmation UI.

tools.name: propose_alarm_change
tools.description: Validate and preview creating, updating, enabling, disabling, or deleting an app-managed alarm template. Never applies it without explicit local confirmation.

tools.name: apply_alarm_change
tools.description: Apply a previously proposed alarm change only with the one-time confirmation token supplied by the local confirmation UI.

tools.name: undo_ai_action
tools.description: Undo a succeeded AI action only when current data still matches its after snapshot.
